_doc: The release cycle's repro builds. Data, not code: each entry is one brief a customer could type, built on its own verified account BESIDE smoke A. Add, remove or reword briefs here; scripts/release_cycle.py knows none of them.

repros.name: coop
repros.brief: Build me a platform for a community bicycle repair co-op: log repair tickets with the bike and the fault, keep a parts inventory with reorder levels, schedule volunteer mechanic shifts, and track member dues.

repros.name: vineyard
repros.brief: Build me a vineyard management platform for a family winery: track fermentation tanks, barrel inventory across two cellars, harvest scheduling by sugar readings, and club member shipments.
